entities.name: Migellic
entities.description: A Wojek League officer, lieutenant in the Tenth Section and later Section Commander of the Central Section and acting Commander-General.

entities.name: Wojek League
entities.description: The Boros police force on Ravnica.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Migellic's superior in the Tenth Section who retired after the Decamillennial.

entities.name: Lannos Nodov
entities.description: The Commander-General away in Prahv during the Nephilim attack.

entities.name: Centerfort
entities.description: The Central Section's base on Ravnica, mostly destroyed in the Nephilim attack.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: Guild whose guildmages tried to activate the Stone Titans.

events.summary: During the quietmen attack on Tenth Leaguehall, Migellic coordinated the defense as highest-ranking officer left.
events.quote: she was the highest-ranking officer left, and she coordinated the defense

events.summary: After Kos retired, Migellic became acting Commander-General.
events.quote: she took over his temporary function of an acting Commander-General for an indefinite time

events.summary: During the Nephilim attack Migellic ordered the wojek to defend their base after the Stone Titans failed to activate.
events.quote: Migellic ordered the wojek to defend their base as best as they could

relations.quote: Migellic was a member of the Wojek League.

relations.note: Subordinate to him in Tenth Section
